_README: Platform-level recruit adapters config. One company = one line. Keys: beisen=<tenant> zhiye.com slug; moka=<org>/<siteId> (derived campus URL) or an object with explicit sites. Value is the canonical company name (string shorthand) or an object {name, host?, ignore_categories?, categories?, sites?}. Adding a line registers the company in qiuzhao.collector.p1_pipeline.REGISTRY via the platform module. Keys: workday=<tenant>/<region>/<site> (CXS); successfactors=<career-site host>. Workday value may be an object {name, search_text (string|{scope:str}), max_list_pages, campus_keywords, intern_keywords}; SuccessFactors value may be {name, query, country, page_size, max_list_pages, campus_keywords, intern_keywords}.
